description: The Guild's social simulation: memories, gossip, grudges and debts (MemoryManager.gd), NPC-to-NPC relationships (RelationsManager.gd) and drama - companies, invitations, romance, grief, feuds, jealousy (DramaManager.gd).

fields.name: fade_per_day
fields.help: Non-core memories lose this share of their weight each day.

fields.name: full_view_rapport
fields.help: Rapport at which the Tavern shows full memories instead of a hint.

fields.name: kinds
fields.help: kind -> {weight, cap, core, text ({about}), you_text (their memory of you), mine_text (your memory of them), hint, grudge, honorable_weight}

fields.name: _doc
fields.help: Notes for designers.

fields.name: max_per_npc
fields.help: Relations each adventurer keeps; the weakest is forgotten.

fields.name: town_pairs_per_day
fields.help: Random pairs of adventurers in town who spend time together each day.

fields.name: compatible
fields.help: Trait pairs that get along: +1 affinity per pair each time they meet in town.

fields.name: clashing
fields.help: Trait pairs that grate: -1 affinity per pair each time they meet.

fields.name: events
fields.help: Affinity changes: job_success, job_fail, job_fail_blame, rescued, rescuer, generous, ledger_rivalry_week, passed_over.

fields.name: blame_traits
fields.help: Traits that blame partners after a failed job.

fields.name: generous_traits
fields.help: Traits that buy rounds (+generous when either has one).

fields.name: thresholds
fields.help: Affinity for friends, sworn, rivals, feud.

fields.name: ripple
fields.help: Share of a rapport change with you that spreads to their friends (and the other way to rivals).

fields.name: ripple_min
fields.help: Smallest rapport change that ripples.

fields.name: pair_with_friend
fields.help: Chance an idle friend comes along on a job.

fields.name: pair_with_sworn
fields.help: Chance an idle sworn companion comes along.

fields.name: group_bonus_per_member
fields.help: Success chance added per extra member on a shared job.

fields.name: rescue_chance
fields.help: Chance a partner drags a dying partner out (they're injured instead).

fields.name: chemistry_mult
fields.help: Affinity per compatible (or clashing) trait pair at each town meeting.

fields.name: familiar_share
fields.help: Share of town meetings with someone they already know (so bonds deepen instead of spreading thin).

fields.name: acquainted_at
fields.help: Affinity at which someone may invite the other along on a job.

fields.name: pair_with_acquaintance
fields.help: Chance an idle acquaintance comes along on a job.

fields.name: weekly_drift
fields.help: Each week every relation moves this much back toward 0 (bonds need tending); at 0 it's forgotten.

fields.name: _doc
fields.help: Notes for designers.

fields.name: companies
fields.help: max_size, join_min_affinity (with every member), adjectives/nouns for names ('The Ember Wardens').

fields.name: invitations
fields.help: chance_per_day, min_rapport (a member's rapport with you), valid_days, max_heroes (you + allies), decline_limit, decline_rapport, victory_rapport, hardship_rapport, guest_days (guests leave if you don't set out).

fields.name: romance
fields.help: weekly_chance for sworn pairs, compatible_mult, aloof_trait (one aloof stops it; two may), pair_mult (partners go on jobs together more).

fields.name: grief
fields.help: days [min,max]; job_chance_mult while grieving; outcomes {vengeance, withdraws, hardens, carries_on: {base, traits: {trait: mult}}}; harden_traits; vengeance_job_chance, vengeance_days, vengeance_feud, avenged_rapport.

fields.name: feuds
fields.help: weekly_chance, cruel_mult, gentle_mult + gentle_traits, lethal_chance (if cruel or level gap >= lethal_level_gap), injury_days, killer_affinity (mourners vs the killer), honourable_conduct, killer_demerits, killer_rank_drop.

fields.name: jealousy
fields.help: archetype + stage that is jealous, margin, affinity per week, gossip_at / sabotage_at (opinion of the rival), gossip_listeners, gossip_affinity, sabotage_chance, caught_chance, caught_affinity, injury_days, break_below (rapport: they turn on you), break_rivalry.
